thread:
devon: heads up — planning kickoff for FY27 GPU buys and region phasing. need alignment on targets, budget envelope, and customer-driven SLAs. starting thread so we don't duplicate in sheets.

olivia: budget note — finance can commit up to $6.5M capex for FY27 procurement in H1, but prefers split across two quarters. need justification by 04/10 for board cycle. :money_with_wings:

matt: high level ask from infra: prefer mix H100 + L40s for inference. H100 for training/large-batch, L40 for cost-effective inference. A100 not attractive unless used for existing reserved contracts. target delivered capacity = 3.5k vGPU-equivalents by EOY27.

ravi: platform requirements: aim for sustained 70% fleet util across peak windows while keeping p99 gen <250ms for hosted tier. this drives instance type mix and region placement.

sara: product voice — two enterprise customers signed on with EU+APAC latency SLOs. must have dedicated capacity in eu-west-2 and ap-south-1 by Q3. they also want canary rollouts and predictable burst for launches.

devon: tradeoffs: latency vs cost. if we prioritize eu and apac reserved hardware we increase cost; alternative is region routing + fallback to hosted cross-region with traffic shifting. open to hybrid.

matt: proposal draft snippet:
```
Phase 1 (Q1-Q2): Purchase 600 H100 (interconnect) + 1200 L40s reserved in us-west-2, eu-west-2 test pool.
Phase 2 (Q3): Top-up 400 L40s + 200 H100 for ap-south-1 pilot. Keep 20% burst buffer in cloud credits.
Phase 3 (Q4): Evaluate utilization, add 15% capacity if avg util >75%.
```

olivia: question — procurement terms? multi-year discounts vs shorter leases? finance prefers 3-year with right-sizing clauses, but ops worried about model shifts making hardware obsolete.

matt: agree. propose 2+1 year lease where year 3 is optional based on utilization and model roadmap. include buyback clause if vendor offers.

ravi: must include telemetry targets in SLA: tagging per-customer, per-model, and per-route. opsneeds: token-level cost signal to enable autoscaling policies.

sara: launch criteria checklist from product side:
- reserved capacity validated in target regions
- canary routing + rollback tested
- cost per 1k tokens within target band
- eval set regression <1% vs baseline

devon: capacity targets we need to lock: baseline throughput 120M tokens/day, burst 300M tokens/day, 95th percentile throughput for model A = 4k concurrent tokens/s. Are those realistic?

matt: baseline looks ok if we meet 3.5k vGPU-equivalents with smart batching/caching. but need to reserve extra KV-cache memory for long-context models — that eats GPU RAM.

olivia: put a contingency budget of 10% aside for network egress and cross-region replication costs. finance will only sign contracts with that cushion.

opsbot: deploy-bot: new procurement ticket created — INFRA-2027-PRCH-1. Assigned: matt. Due: 2026-10-15.

devon: next steps:
- matt: finalize hardware mix + vendor shortlist by 2026-09-30
- olivia: confirm budget release path by 2026-10-04
- ravi: define telemetry + tagging schema by 2026-10-07
- sara: provide top-3 customer SLOs and launch dates by 2026-10-01

matt: noted. I'll add rough TCO comparison (H100 vs L40 vs cloud burst) and expected utilization curves.

ravi: also adding a low-priority option: test on-prem appliance for regulated EU customer — needs separate cost line.

sara: can we fast-follow apac pilot if utilization in eu >85%? that would shift Q3 buys forward.

olivia: conditional approval: if utilization >80% and customer commitments >$1.2M ARR, finance will accelerate payment.

devon: cool. I'll spin this into the roadmap doc and sync with product planning next week. we should keep this thread as the canonical decision record. :white_check_mark:

matt: ping me if you want the raw vendor quotes. will attach in INFRA-2027-PRCH-1.

olivia: thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: once you ack the action items.
